name: Multi-Task Differentiable Loss for 3D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Differentiable Loss Functions for Shape Reconstruction
definition: A set of loss functions used to optimize 3D Gaussians from video input, combining segmentation mask loss, color loss, and optical flow loss.
summary: Multi-Task Differentiable Loss for 3D Gaussian Splatting optimizes shape, appearance, and motion by combining mask, color, and flow losses weighted by alpha, distinguishing itself from methods relying solely on geometric smoothness.
